title: "Day 3 – Robustness and the multiverse"
---
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
**Slides.** The deck of the three days is in preparation, and the [slides page](slides.qmd) shows the deck of the earlier three-day course meanwhile.
:::

Day 3 moves from reproduction to robustness. It sets out the question behind the claim and the choices that lie between the data and a result, explains the methods behind each choice, and gives most of its time to independent work. Each participant designs an analysis, preregisters it, runs it and adds it to the class chart, where it sits beside the results of the class and the 864 specifications of the curve of the claim. The day runs as four sessions of ninety minutes.

## 1. The estimand and the graph

[Read Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The first session writes the estimand statement behind the claim and draws the causal graph that says what each adjustment does, in Task 2 of the workspace.

## 2. The specification menu

[Open the specification menu](../../cases/eu-frames/menu.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the decision map](../../cases/eu-frames/map.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The second session goes through every decision on the menu of the case, with the options of each and the methods behind them. The methods are in the modules on [fixed and random effects, and few clusters](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd), [the items behind the scales](../../companion/measurement.qmd), [weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd), [missing answers](../../companion/missingness.qmd) and [respondents in country-years](../../companion/individual-level.qmd).

## 3. A design of your own

**In your workspace**, Tasks 4 and 5 of the report.

The third session is independent work. Choose one option for each decision, fill in the preregistration block of the report, and send an exploration to the class chart before you declare.

## 4. The multiverse

[Open the Multiverse page](../../cases/eu-frames/multiverse.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Read The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The last session runs the declared analysis, reports it and sends it to the class chart. It then reads the chart against the curve of the claim, the five reanalyses and the replications, and asks what a curve can and cannot establish.

**By the end of the day** you have a preregistered analysis of your own, run and reported, and you can place it among the defensible alternatives and say what the curve of the claim does and does not show.
